1283-1651-3129-4365-8276.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Hive by paying {5} and tapping it, creating four 1/1 Wasp artifact creature tokens due to Primal Vigor and Mondrak.
Activate Clock of Omens twice by tapping the Wasps, untapping Chromatic Orrery and The Hive.
Repeat.
1283-1651-3129-4365-8276.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

225-2577-2921-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
225-2577-2921-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5086-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Triskelavus.
When Triskelavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
5086-6495-6972.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

851-4094-5478-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2
851-4094-5478-6753-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the other Angel on the battlefield

3259-7296-7917--185.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7296-7917--185.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Seluma, triggering both Breath of Fury and Seluma.
Resolve the Seluma trigger, returning an Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Angel returned in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-7296-7917--185.notes: One of the two additional Angels must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard. If both chosen Angels have haste, then Gimli's Reckless Might can be omitted.

2908-3821-5542.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
2908-3821-5542.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2713-3094-4659-4785-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2713-3094-4659-4785-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {1} due to Zirda and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

2510-3532-5078-7314.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-3532-5078-7314.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Baxter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1409-2557-3671.description:
Activate Wily Goblin by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Wily Goblin enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Wily Goblin.
Resolve the Wily Goblin trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1409-4772-5421.description:
Activate Redcap Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Redcap Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Redcap Thief.
Resolve the Redcap Thief trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-5226-6754.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5226-6754.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Eusocial Engineering and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

955-3490-4289-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
955-3490-4289-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2173-5010-5708-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

3558-5220-6797-6900.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

215-3390-3518-5334-6865.description:
Cast Astelli Reclaimer for its warp cost by paying {2}{W}.
When Astelli Reclaimer enters, it triggers twice, returning Lion's Eye Diamond and Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Astelli Raclaimer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-3390-3518-5334-6865.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can continue the combo returning any noncreature, nonland permanents with mana value 5 or less. You should instead cast Astelli Reclaimer for its normal mana cost in this case.

522-2111-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Repeat.

813-2072-3617.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Walk and Scrollshift.
813-2072-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Scrollshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk and Scrollshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2136-4222-6252.notablePrerequisites:
Boommobile is a creature.
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Orthion.
2136-4222-6252.description:
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Boommobile with haste.
When the Boommobile token enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {U}{U}{U}{U} or {R}{R}{R}{R} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Orthion.
Repeat.
2136-4222-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target other creature(s) using Orthion's ability or activate a Boommobile's ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

851-3875-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
851-3875-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
851-3875-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner each trigger twice.
Resolve both Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

710-2730-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

407-2608-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Swamps.
407-2608-4499.description:
Activate Cabal Coffers by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cabal Coffers.
Repeat.

232-2617-4613-5917.notablePrerequisites:
Midnight Guard has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Midnight Guard does not have summoning sickness.
232-2617-4613-5917.description:
Activate Midnight Guard using The Jolly Balloon Man's ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
When the Priest of Urabrask token enters the battlefield, it and Midnight Guard trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask token's trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Midnight Guard trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.
232-2617-4613-5917.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other creature using step 1 instead.

974-2532-3525.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-2532-3525.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Smaug with haste.
Put the newest Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first Smaug trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the second Smaug trigger, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Jaxis.
Repeat from step 3.

67-2438-2525.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double leaves the battlefield, it triggers its Reveillark ability, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Reveillark.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

132-198-3525.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {U} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.

262-671-859.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Lurking Roper.
262-671-859.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, they trigger Daxos four times.
Resolve the first Daxos trigger, causing you to gain one life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

819-1395-3584-5195.notablePrerequisites: You have cast at least one instant and/or sorcery this turn.
819-1395-3584-5195.description:
Cast any spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Memory Lapse either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}{U}, targeting that spell.
Elsha, Thousand-Year Storm and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Thousand-Year Storm trigger, creating at least one copy of Memory Lapse, with each copy targeting the original Memory Lapse.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers for each copy made this way, creating at least one Treasure token.
Resolve the first copy of Memory Lapse, countering the original Memory Lapse and putting it on top of your library.
All remaining copies of Memory Lapse fizzle due to having no legal target.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.
